run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute maximum stock profit with at most k transactions
test_f_gold: test f_gold against parameter sets and compare results to f_filled
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold dynamic programming algorithm for stock trading profit
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function for correctness on edge cases like negative prices
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to reduce space complexity from O(k*n) to O(n)
